lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੰ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa nagaree sabade khoje naam nava(n) nidh paaee ||22||
lines.translation: One who searches the village of the body, through the Shabad, obtains the nine treasures of the Naam. ||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: manasaa maar man sahaj samaanaa bin rasanaa usatat karaaee ||23||
lines.translation: Conquering desire, the mind is absorbed in intuitive ease, and then one chants the Lord's Praises without speaking. ||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਇਣ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਦਿਸਟਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: loin dekh rahe bisamaadee chit adisat lagaaee ||24||
lines.translation: Let your eyes gaze upon the Wondrous Lord; let your consciousness be attached to the Unseen Lord. ||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: adisat sadaa rahai niraalam jotee jot milaaee ||25||
lines.translation: The Unseen Lord is forever absolute and immaculate; one's light merges into the Light. ||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: hau gur saalaahee sadaa aapanaa jin saachee boojh bujhaaee ||26||
lines.translation: I praise my Guru forever, who has inspired me to understand this true understanding. ||26||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨੭॥੨॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ek kahai bena(n)tee naavahu gat pat paaee ||27||2||11||
lines.translation: Nanak offers this one prayer: through the Name, may I find salvation and honor. ||27||2||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Raamkalee, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਦੁਲੰਭ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har kee poojaa dula(n)bh hai sa(n)tahu kahanaa kachhoo na jaaee ||1||
lines.translation: It is so hard to obtain that devotional worship of the Lord, O Saints. It cannot be described at all. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tahu guramukh pooraa paaee ||
lines.translation: O Saints, as Gurmukh, find the Perfect Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੋ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naamo pooj karaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: and worship the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਪੂਜ ਚੜਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har bin sabh kichh mailaa sa(n)tahu kiaa hau pooj chaRaaee ||2||
lines.translation: Without the Lord, everything is filthy, O Saints; what offering should I place before Him? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har saache bhaavai saa poojaa hovai bhaanaa man vasaaee ||3||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases the True Lord is devotional worship; His Will abides in the mind. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: poojaa karai sabh lok sa(n)tahu manamukh thaai na paaee ||4||
lines.translation: Everyone worships Him, O Saints, but the self-willed manmukh is not accepted or approved. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਏਹ ਪੂਜਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sabad marai man niramal sa(n)tahu eh poojaa thaai paaee ||5||
lines.translation: If someone dies in the Word of the Shabad, his mind become immaculate, O Saints; such worship is accepted and approved. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਵਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: pavit paavan se jan saache ek sabad liv laaee ||6||
lines.translation: Sanctified and pure are those true beings, who enshrine love for the Shabad. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰ ਪੂਜ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀ ਲੋਕਾਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai hor pooj na hovee bharam bhulee lokaaee ||7||
lines.translation: There is no worship of the Lord, other than the Name; the world wanders, deluded by doubt. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh aap pachhaanai sa(n)tahu raam naam liv laaee ||8||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh understands his own self, O Saints; he lolvingly centers his mind on the Lord's Name. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਈ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: aape niramal pooj karaae gurasabadee thaai paaee ||9||
lines.translation: The Immaculate Lord Himself inspires worship of Him; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is accepted and approved. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: poojaa karahi par bidh nahee jaanahi doojai bhaai mal laaee ||10||
lines.translation: Those who worship Him, but do not know the Way, are polluted with the love of duality. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai s poojaa jaanai bhaanaa man vasaaee ||11||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh, knows what worship is; the Lord's Will abides within his mind. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਣੇ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਅੰਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhaane te sabh sukh paavai sa(n)tahu a(n)te naam sakhaaee ||12||
lines.translation: One who accepts the Lord's Will obtains total peace, O Saints; in the end, the Naam will be our help and support. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: apanaa aap na pachhaanahi sa(n)tahu kooR karahi vadiaaee ||13||
lines.translation: One who does not understand his own self, O Saints, falsely flatters himself. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਕੀਨੈ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਛੋਡੈ ਲੈ ਜਾਸੀ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: paakha(n)d keenai jam nahee chhodai lai jaasee pat gavaaee ||14||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death does not give up on those who practices hypocrisy; they are dragged away in disgrace. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: jin a(n)tar sabad aap pachhaanahi gat mit tin hee paaee ||15||
lines.translation: Those who have the Shabad deep within, understand themselves; they find the way of salvation. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: ehu manooaa su(n)n samaadh lagaavai jotee jot milaaee ||16||
lines.translation: Their minds enter into the deepest state of Samaadhi, and their light is absorbed into the Light. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਈ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: sun sun guramukh naam vakhaanahi satasa(n)gat melaaee ||17||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs listen constantly to the Naam, and chant it in the True Congregation. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh gaavai aap gavaavai dar saachai sobhaa paaee ||18||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs sing the Lord's Praises, and erase self-conceit; they obtain true honor in the Court of the Lord. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: saachee baanee sach vakhaanai sach naam liv laaee ||19||
lines.translation: True are their words; they speak only the Truth; they lovingly focus on the True Name. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਅਤਿ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਖੰਜਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: bhai bha(n)jan at paap nikha(n)jan meraa prabh a(n)t sakhaaee ||20||
lines.translation: My God is the Destroyer of fear, the Destroyer of sin; in the end, He is our only help and support. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨੧॥੩॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap varatai naanak naam vadiaaee ||21||3||12||
lines.translation: He Himself pervades and permeates everything; O Nanak, glorious greatness is obtained through the Naam. ||21||3||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Raamkalee, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਕੁਚਲ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਅਤਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ham kuchal kucheel at abhimaanee mil sabade mail utaaree ||1||
lines.translation: I am filthy and polluted, proud and egotistical; receiving the Word of the Shabad, my filth is taken away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tahu guramukh naam nisataaree ||
lines.translation: O Saints, the Gurmukhs are saved through the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa naam vasiaa ghat a(n)tar karatai aap savaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The True Name abides deep within their hearts. The Creator Himself embellishes them. ||1||Pause||
